articles.title: Rams take Simpson, note 'this is Matthew's team'
articles.summary: The Rams selected quarterback Ty Simpson with the 13th pick in the NFL draft, though coach Sean McVay made it clear: "This is Matthew's team."

articles.title: Amid Brown buzz, Eagles trade up for WR Lemon
articles.summary: The Eagles made a trade with the division rival Cowboys and selected USC wide receiver Makai Lemon with the No. 20 pick.

articles.title: Cowboys 'changed face' of D via Downs, Lawrence
articles.summary: After taking Ohio State safety Caleb Downs at No. 11, thanks to a trade with the Dolphins, the Cowboys selected UCF edge rusher Malachi Lawrence with the 23rd pick after moving down from No. 20 in a trade with the Eagles.

articles.title: Jets pick 3 players from CFP teams in 1st round
articles.summary: The Jets selected three players in the first round Thursday night -- DE David Bailey at No. 2, TE Kenyon Sadiq at 16 and WR Omar Cooper Jr. at No. 30.

articles.title: 'Ecstatic' Mendoza goes to Raiders with top pick
articles.summary: The Raiders made it official at the NFL draft, taking former Indiana star quarterback Fernando Mendoza with the No. 1 pick.

articles.title: Chiefs: 'Top-5 guy' in CB Delane worth trade up
articles.summary: The Chiefs moved up in the NFL draft Thursday night, acquiring the No. 6 pick from the Browns and using it to select LSU cornerback Mansoor Delane. Cleveland took Spencer Fano at No. 9.

articles.title: Vrabel: Confident in Pats during draft absence
articles.summary: Mike Vrabel said he is confident that the Patriots will have a successful draft during his absence Saturday, when he will start seeking counseling after multiple media outlets posted photos of the coach with former Athletic reporter Dianna Russini.

articles.title: Giants thrilled with picks: 'Couldn't do any better'
articles.summary: The Giants addressed both sides of the ball in the first round of the NFL draft, selecting Ohio State linebacker Arvell Reese with the fifth pick and Miami offensive lineman Francis Mauigoa at No. 10.

articles.summary: The Vikings made one of the boldest and riskiest selections Thursday in the first round of the NFL draft, choosing Florida defensive lineman Caleb Banks at No. 18.

articles.title: 49ers keep Jones, surprised no Day 1 pick offered
articles.summary: Kyle Shanahan indicated that not only would Mac Jones be on the Niners next season but if any team was going to deal for him, it likely would have needed to involve a first-round pick.

articles.title: Bucs draft Bain, confident in former Miami star
articles.summary: The Buccaneers selected Rueben Bain Jr. with the 15th pick in the NFL draft, less than two weeks after news surfaced that the ex-Miami star was involved in a motor vehicle accident that resulted in the death of a passenger in 2024.

articles.title: Host Steelers draft Iheanachor to boost O-line
articles.summary: With the 21st pick, the Steelers drafted offensive tackle Max Iheanachor from Arizona State.

articles.title: Love to Cards, highest-drafted RB since Saquon
articles.summary: The Cardinals selected former Notre Dame star Jeremiyah Love with the third pick in the NFL draft, making him the highest-drafted RB since Saquon Barkley went No. 2 in 2018.

articles.title: Source: Cowboys' Pickens to sign franchise tag
articles.summary: Cowboys wide receiver George Pickens is signing his franchise tender Thursday, a day after the team said it would not be negotiating a long-term contract with him this year, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Pearce OK's intervention program to avoid trial
articles.summary: The Falcons' James Pearce Jr. has agreed to enter an intervention program, allowing him to avoid trial on felony charges stemming from an alleged incident with WNBA player Rickea Jackson.
